title: A fibre nonzerodivisor cuts a flat hypersurface near the point
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], let $x\in X$ with $s=f(x)$, and suppose $f$ is flat at $x$ [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $h\in\mathfrak m_x\subset\mathcal O_{X,x}$ be a germ whose image $\bar h$ in $\mathcal O_{X_s,x}$ is a nonzerodivisor (multiplication by $\bar h$ is injective), where $X_s$ is the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. There exist an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq X$ of $x$ and $a\in B$ with germ $h$ such that the closed subscheme $D=\operatorname{Spec}(B/(a))\hookrightarrow U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] contains $x$, and the composite $D\to U\to X\to S$ is flat and locally of finite presentation.

source.place: Tag 056Y, label lemma-slice-given-element; forget the additional assertion that D is an effective Cartier divisor.

proof.text: Apply the flat affine chart lemma to $f,x,h$. Obtain $x\in U_1=\operatorname{Spec}B$, $s\in V=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $f(U_1)\subseteq V$, a flat finitely presented map $A\to B$, and $a\in B$ with germ exactly $h$. Its point prime $\mathfrak q$ contains $a$, because $h\in\mathfrak m_x$; write $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q\cap A$.

source.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof, first paragraph: affine shrinking, openness of flatness and extension of the prescribed germ (old steps 1–2)

proof.text: Apply the prescribed-section model lemma to this $A\to B$ and $a$. Choose $A_0\subseteq A$, $B_0$, $a_0$ and $e:A\otimes_{A_0}B_0\cong B$ as stated there. In particular $A_0,B_0$ are Noetherian, $A_0\to B_0$ is flat and finitely presented, and $e(1\otimes a_0)=a$. Contract $\mathfrak q$ and $\mathfrak p$ to $\mathfrak q_0$ and $\mathfrak p_0$.

source.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof, second paragraph: flat Noetherian approximation with descent of the chosen section (old steps 3–5)

proof.text: The fibre-stalk quotient lemma identifies $\mathcal O_{X_s,x}$ with $B_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak q}$, carrying $\bar h$ to the image of $a$. Apply the model-fibre regularity lemma to $e$ and these primes. The hypothesis on $\bar h$ therefore yields a regular singleton $\bar a_0$ in $C_0=(B_0)_{\mathfrak q_0}/\mathfrak p_0(B_0)_{\mathfrak q_0}$; its nonzero-quotient condition is part of the cited conclusion.

source.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof, second paragraph: residue-field base change of fibre local rings and faithful-flat descent of the chosen nonzerodivisor (old steps 6–7)

proof.text: All hypotheses of the Noetherian quotient-neighbourhood lemma now hold: both model rings are Noetherian, the model map is flat and finitely presented, $a_0\in\mathfrak q_0$, and its closed-fibre image is a regular singleton. Choose its $g_0\notin\mathfrak q_0$ with $H_0=(B_0)_{g_0}/(a_0)$ flat over $A_0$. Its image $g=e(1\otimes g_0)$ avoids $\mathfrak q$ by the definition of contraction.

source.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof, last paragraph: Grothendieck local flatness and openness for the principal quotient (old steps 8–9)

proof.text: Apply the model principal-quotient return lemma to the affine charts $U_1,V$, the isomorphism $e$, and $a_0,g_0$. It supplies the affine neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}B_g$, the restricted section with unchanged germ $h$, and the principal closed subscheme $D$ containing $x$, whose actual composite to $S$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Rename $B_g$ as $B$ and the restricted section as $a$ to obtain exactly the asserted witnesses.

source.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof, second paragraph, return from the cartesian model, and conclusion: explicit quotient base change, stalk flatness and finite presentation (old steps 10–12)

proof_origin.place: Tag 056Y, lemma-slice-given-element, proof; the flat quotient part of the Noetherian approximation argument, omitting the additional effective-Cartier-divisor assertion and its annihilator calculation.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_flat_hypersurface_of_fiber_regular {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (x : X) (hflat : (f.stalkMap x).hom.Flat) (h : X.presheaf.stalk x) (hh : h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (hregular : Function.Injective (fun z : (f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber x) ↦ (f.fiberStalkMap x).hom h * z)) : ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hx : x ∈ U) (a : Γ(X, U)), X.presheaf.germ U x hx a = h ∧ x ∈ Set.range (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) ≫ hU.fromSpec) ∧ Flat (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) ≫ hU.fromSpec ≫ f) ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) ≫ hU.fromSpec ≫ f)
